title: Hivemind workflow representation, security, embedding, chunking, evaluation, and rollback contract

delimiters.grammar: A block starts at a line whose rstrip() equals a recognized literal; the Python text runs until the next recognized delimiter line, the 'Workflow semantics (rule-based):' marker, or end of body. The delimiter line is not part of the returned Python. No markdown fence is emitted by VibeComfy.

cohorts.matching_method: Deterministic over all 2757 kind=workflow rows fetched via PostgREST (counts exact). payload_python = non-empty payload.python_source. body_python = recognized delimited block present. both = payload bytes also form the body block. neither = neither location. recoverable/unavailable require running the VibeComfy exporter (local artifact access) and are not observable from the DB; split deferred.
cohorts.uncertainty: The recoverable/unavailable split of the 2535 'neither' rows is unknown. Bounded sample (schema map, first 200 workflows) showed 199/200 carry corpus_path, suggesting recoverable is likely the majority but UNCONFIRMED. The quarantined count under the safe (trap-free) policy is unknown; the only task-0.3 reason code (high_entropy_base64) is rejected as a false-positive trap, so the real count is expected near zero but must be measured at remediation. Two data-quality anomalies (source='s', source='comfyui') are out of scope for cohort math.

state_transitions.recoverable_to_payload_python: Remediation materializes payload.python_source from the VibeComfy exporter (idempotent, high-water monotonic).
state_transitions.body_python_to_payload_python: Remediation promotes the body block into payload.
state_transitions.unavailable_to_other: A later authoritative source artifact (new ingestion / operator repair) moves the row; identity external_resources.id is unchanged.
state_transitions.both_to_dedup: Remediation re-renders body with the Python block present exactly once; canonical prose strips the duplicate block.
state_transitions.safe_to_quarantined: Only via re-scan on content change; quarantine never auto-clears without operator review and secret rotation.

order: 1. Non-empty payload.python_source is authoritative (cohort payload_python; body_duplicate flagged if the same bytes form a body block).
2. Else a recognized body-delimited block is authoritative (cohort body_python).
3. Else deterministic VibeComfy recovery (cohort recoverable; no LLM, no execution).
4. Else cohort unavailable with an explicit reason; prose remains searchable.
precedence.canonical_python_representation: workflow_python = the authoritative bytes from the precedence above; never a second copy recovered from prose.

no_duplication.rule: When payload.python_source bytes also occur as the delimited body block, remove that block from the canonical prose representation before hashing, embedding, and lexical-document construction. Never embed or index both copies.
no_duplication.hashing: representation_hash over the full canonical representation; chunk_hash per chunk; the two are independent hash columns.
no_duplication.gate: count of (workflow, representation bytes) embedded or indexed more than once == 0

identity_version_hash.immutable_identity: entity_type + item_id (representation_type and chunk_index are representation identity, not row identity)
identity_version_hash.normalization: Unicode NFC; CRLF/CR -> LF; per-line trailing whitespace stripped; stripped to a stable form with a single trailing newline convention. Identical inputs yield identical hashes.
identity_version_hash.hash_skip: re-canonicalize recomputes the hash; if unchanged, skip re-embed/re-index (idempotent).

structured_projection.embedded_into: workflow prose canonical text (not arbitrary payload/workflow_json/compiled_api)

safe_retrieval.matched_snippet: bounded (<=240 chars) window around the matched span; secret-redacted via the same scanner (defense in depth); never the matched secret value.
safe_retrieval.get_item_representation_python: returns whitelisted full payload.python_source (or recovered authoritative) + representation version/hash; rejects if not kind=workflow; fails closed if quarantined; never returns arbitrary payload, corpus_path, workflow_json, or compiled_api wholesale.

secret_scanner.policy: Deterministic, fail-closed. A hit quarantines the representation from public lexical/embedding/snippet/full-code retrieval and records only non-secret reason codes. New ingestion fails closed; historical hits enter the documented remove/rotate incident path.
secret_scanner.trap_fix: high_entropy_base64 is explicitly NOT a reason code. The task-0.3 inventory flagged all 222 Python-bearing workflows with high_entropy_base64 because VibeComfy-generated source legitimately embeds large base64/JSON literals. A bare high-entropy run with no credential context is benign. Matches require structure: a key block, a known provider prefix of credential length, a credential-keyword assignment with a high-entropy RHS, a user:pass@ URL, or an AWS env var.

tiers.provider_token_prefix: openai sk-/sk-proj-, github ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_, slack xox[abprs]-, aws AKIA/ASIA, google AIza, stripe sk_live_/rk_live_, supabase sb_secret_ (publishable sb_publishable_ is public and excluded), hivemind contributor hm_<64hex>, structured JWT eyJ...eyJ...sig
tiers.credential_assignment: credential-keyword LHS (api_key/apikey/secret/password/passwd/token/access_token/refresh_token/private_key/client_secret/authorization) assigned a quoted high-entropy string of length>=16
tiers.credential_url: scheme://user:password@host with a non-placeholder password of length>=6
tiers.aws_env_var: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY assignment with a plausible value

secret_scanner.logging_rule: Never log, echo, serialize, hash-to-client, or include the matched value in metadata, reports, snippets, or reason objects. Record only {reason_code, bounded position, scanner_version}.

recovery.exporters: Reuse VibeComfy's existing emit_ready_template_python / emit_scratchpad_python / _fallback_python_archive_source via port_convert_workflow / load_workflow_any. No second generator in Hivemind; no LLM inference; no execution of stored Python.
recovery.no_overwrite: Never overwrite a non-empty payload.python_source. Recovery only fills empty payload from a body delimiter, or regenerates from workflow_json/compiled_api/corpus_path/provenance when both payload and body lack Python.
recovery.corpus_path: Resolved only in an authorized operator job with an explicit VibeComfy root; Edge/search requests never read local paths.
requirements: monotonic by high-water (never restore older over newer authoritative source)
never infer Python from prose with an LLM
refresh lexical state only after the source-row patch commits

embedding_pilot.note: Frozen pilot candidates only. The production winner is chosen at task 2.14 by evaluation; this contract does NOT preselect it.

candidates.role: quality fallback (0.7: full corpus 16.4 GB FAIL; viable only at pilot/cohort scope)

embedding_pilot.contract_identity: contract_id = provider + model + dimension + canonicalization_version + chunking_version; one active contract per dimension
embedding_pilot.dimension_migration: Separate fixed-dimension table + HNSW index; atomic active-contract switch only after replacement coverage passes; never mix dimensions in one table.
embedding_pilot.vector_validation: finite, no NaN/Inf, exact dimension D, L2-normalized at write and at query; wrong-dimension -> fail closed (skip+count+retry); cosine via <=>
embedding_pilot.query_normalization: same text normalization as corpus canonicalization; embed once per request; timeout ~400ms; best-effort per-instance cache; failure -> lexical degradation + semantic_degraded
embedding_pilot.secret_boundary: provider key only in Hivemind Edge secret store (OPENAI_API_KEY, task 2.1 setup) for query embeddings; operator-run backfill reads the approved provider credential from an authorized local/managed environment; never in pack/repo/client; deterministic fake embedder for unit/contract tests

chunking.estimate: chars/4 token heuristic (frozen planner estimate; real tokenizer in task 2.6)
chunking.overlap_offsets: record chunk_index, content chunk_hash, method, and stable source offsets; deterministic -> repeated runs identical
chunking.parser_fallback: On ast.parse failure or a single literal node exceeding the budget (generated archives), fall back to a bounded line/token window with overlap; never require execution.
chunking.best_chunk_collapse: Collapse to one best chunk per (entity_type, item_id) across representation types before RRF.
chunking.no_silent_truncation: Never silently truncate searchable or embeddable Python; split into bounded chunks. Measured worst case payload.python_source max 1,415,262 chars (~354K tokens) -> ~76 chunks at 512 tokens.
chunking.bounded_lexical_code_document: Full canonical Python participates in lexical retrieval (imports, symbols, node classes, model filenames, kwargs, fragments) via a bounded code-document arm; over-limit documents are split per (resource_id, representation_type, chunk_index) and collapsed to the resource identity before global ranking; never silent-truncate.

golden_set.freeze_rule: No post-hoc threshold changes after Phase 1/2/3 runs; re-judging only via a versioned v2 sibling.

invariants: source rows never modified or deleted on rollback
failed/stale jobs remain inspectable and retryable

stages.lexical: Roll back via client mode=legacy (two-pass ILIKE). The lexical RPC/tsvector columns/indexes are additive; drop or rebuild indexes in an approved maintenance window. STOP if exact_identifier Recall@10 < 0.95, workflow-code exact-match < 0.95, or non-validation error >= 0.5%.
stages.embedding_pilot: Keep vectors; disable semantic retrieval (no deletion) if quality regresses or a capacity/cost gate is crossed; resume from the durable cursor and content hashes. STOP at any capacity gate ($25 / 12 GB / $50mo), coverage below gate, or stale-hash >= 0.1%.
stages.workflow_remediation: Separately resumable from its own cursor; never restore an older representation over a newer authoritative source; high-water monotonic; on rollback leave payload untouched and mark the remediation run superseded. STOP if any non-empty payload is overwritten or any unavailable/quarantined row lacks a reason.
stages.hnsw: Drop or rebuild the index in an approved maintenance window; retain embedding rows for diagnosis; never delete source. STOP on capacity pressure or destabilizing ingestion/search.
stages.edge: Per-request degradation to lexical; provider/service-role secrets stay server-side; roll back to lexical/legacy via flag. STOP immediately on any credential leak, or on error/latency gate failure.
stages.canary: Retain lexical and legacy overrides; one-configuration-change rollback. STOP on any release-blocking metric.
stages.production_backfill: Cohort-gated with pause/resume; source data never modified. STOP at any cohort gate or storage/cost gate.
